_설명: 완성 5과 부정사 — 보기 순서만 섞여 있던 객관식을 손으로 새로 썼다. 묻는 것과 푸는 방법은 그대로 두고 문장과 보기를 바꿨다. 종합1 32번은 원본 지문이 중간에 잘려 있어 틀린 자리를 옮길 수 없으므로 손대지 않았다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장과 의미가 통하는 것은?
body: <보기> The soup was so hot that the child couldn't
choices: The soup was too hot of the child to drink.
The soup was hot so that the child could drink.
The soup was too hot for the child to drink.
The soup was too hot for the child not to drink.
The soup was hot enough for the child to drink.
문항.explanation: 의미상 주어는 「for + 목적격」으로 쓰고, to부정사의 목적어는 다시 쓰지 않는다.

문항.포인트: To be brief = To make a long story short
문항.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 같은 것은?
body: <보기> [[To be brief]], I won't take part in the
choices: To make a long story short
문항.explanation: ‘간단히 말하면’이라는 뜻이므로 To make a long story short와 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

문항.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 [[틀린]]것은?
choices: I didn't mean to ask you [[to wait]] here.
She devoted herself [[to teach]] the poor.
My mother told me [[not to skip]] breakfast.
I really want him [[to join]] us on the trip.
His boss advised him [[to take]] a short break.
문항.explanation: devote oneself to의 to는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사 teaching이 와야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 각 문장에서 어법상 어색한 부분을 올바르게고친 것으로 옳지 [[않은]]것은?
body: ⒜The captain ordered the sailors lower the sails.
⒝Sadly, the injury caused him give up the race.
⒞Dr. Kim devoted his life cure rare diseases.
⒟This trip will teach you be more patient.
⒠The new app enabled us find the way easily.
문항.explanation: devote ~ to의 to는 전치사이므로 curing으로 고쳐야 한다.

문항.prompt: 각 문장을 동일한 의미의 다른 문장으로 바꿔 쓸때, 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 적절한 말을 순서대로짝지은 것은?
body: ⒜I am sorry that I forgot your birthday last week.
= I am sorry to (A)_______ your birthday last week.
⒝It is said that this temple was rebuilt in the 15th
= This temple is said to (B)_______ in the 15th
choices: have been forgotten have been rebuilt
문항.explanation: 본동사보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사를 쓰고, 절이 수동이면 have been + 과거분사로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 바꾸어쓴 것은?
body: Under the motto "Ten minutes, meet a book!",
the Library Week offers readers programs that
encourage people [[read]] more in their daily lives.
문항.explanation: encourage는 목적격보어로 to부정사를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장을 영작할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장적절한 것은?
body: <보기> 그녀는 그 회의에 참석하지 않았던 것 같다.
문항.explanation: 앞선 때의 일을 부정하므로 not to have + 과거분사로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장에서 [[틀린]]부분을 찾아 바르게 고친 것은?
문항.explanation: 뒤의 to부정사가 진목적어이므로 가목적어 it을 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 각 문장을 동일한 의미의 다른 문장으로 바꿔 쓸때, 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 적절한 말을 순서대로짝지은 것은?
body: ⒜He promised that he would not tell anyone the
⒝She decided that she would not join the club.
choices: to not tell to not join
not to tell not to join
not to tell to not join
문항.explanation: to부정사를 부정할 때는 to 앞에 not을 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 문장과 의미가 통하면서 어법상 옳은 것은?
body: <보기> The old man is too weak to climb the stairs
choices: The old man is weak, but climbs the stairs that lead to his room.
The old man is so weak that he can climb the stairs that lead to his room.
The old man is so weak and yet tries to climb the stairs that lead to his room.
The old man is weak so that he can‘t climb the stairs that lead to his room.
The old man is so weak that he can’t climb the stairs that lead to his room.
문항.explanation: 「too ~ to」는 「so ~ that + 주어 + can’t」로 바꿔 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장에 쓰인 to부정사의 용법이 나머지와 [[다른]]것은?
choices: There is something warm to wear in the closet.
I think we have many things to prepare before the trip.
The doctor didn’t have enough time to see all the patients.
It is important to keep a regular sleep schedule.
This river is a dangerous place to swim in because the current is strong.
문항.explanation: ④만 가주어 It에 대한 진주어로 쓰인 명사적 용법이고, 나머지는 앞의 명사를 꾸민다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 [[틀린]]문장은?
choices: Teachers should give students topics to talk about.
It wasn’t kind of him not to help his friend.
I expect the new bridge to complete soon.
She was glad to hear that we liked her cooking.
I hope to have the chance to travel with my family soon.
문항.explanation: 다리는 완공되는 쪽이므로 to be completed로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 문장과 의미가 통하면서 어법상 옳은 것은?
body: <보기> This hall is wide enough to hold 500
choices: This hall is as wide as the space for 500 guests.
This hall is so wide that it cannot hold 500 guests.
This hall is such wide that it can hold 500 guests.
This hall is so wide that it can hold 500 guests.
This hall is enough wide but it is not used to hold 500 guests.
문항.explanation: 「형용사 + enough + to부정사」는 「so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + can」으로 바꿔 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 it의 의미가 나머지와 [[다]] [[른]]것은?
choices: [[It]] was so careless of me to lose your book.
[[It]] has taken many months to finish this project.
If the jacket doesn’t fit, bring [[it]] back and we will change it.
Some people don’t think [[it]] is wrong to copy others’ work.
[[It]] is not right to cut down trees that give shade to the village.
문항.explanation: ③만 앞의 명사를 가리키는 대명사이고 나머지는 to부정사를 대신하는 가주어·가목적어이다.

문항.prompt: 주어진 우리말을 영작할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로알맞은 것은?
body: <보기> 솔직히 말하면, 나는 그 결과가 마음에 들지 않는다.
문항.explanation: ‘솔직히 말하면’은 To be frank with you이다.

문항.포인트: To make a long story short = To be brief
문항.prompt: 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 같은 것은?
body: <보기> [[To make a long story short]], he gave up
문항.explanation: ‘간단히 말하면’이라는 뜻이므로 To be brief와 같다.

문항.포인트: It is + 형용사 + for + 목적격 + to부정사
문항.prompt: 주어진 문장과 같은 의미가 되도록 올바르게 영작한 것은?
body: <보기> It’s important that she should keep the
choices: It's important to keep the promise.
She is important to keep the promise.
It's important her to keep the promise.
It's important of her to keep the promise.
It's important for her to keep the promise.
문항.explanation: important는 사람의 성질을 나타내는 형용사가 아니므로 의미상 주어에 for를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 [[다른]]문장은?
choices: It's very kind ____ you to help me.
I am waiting ____ her to call me back.
The writer wrote the letter ____ him to read.
I think it's hard ____ them to finish it today.
This trip will be a good chance ____ you to learn about nature.
문항.explanation: kind는 사람의 성질을 나타내므로 of를 쓰고 나머지는 for를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 주어진 문장과 같은 뜻인 것을 고르면?
body: <보기> It seems that he had lost his way in the
choices: It seems to have lost his way in the forest.
It seems him to have lost his way in the forest.
He seems to lose his way in the forest.
He seems to have lost his way in the forest.
He seemed to lose his way in the forest.
문항.explanation: that절이 주절보다 앞선 때이므로 완료부정사 to have lost로 바꾼다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
body: <보기> I didn’t expect that he would accept the
문항.explanation: expect는 to부정사를 목적어로 쓰며 to 뒤에 조동사를 쓰지 않는다.

문항.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 영작할 때, 빈칸에 가장 적절한 것은?
문항.explanation: 「tell + 목적어 + to부정사」의 형태로 쓰며 부정은 to 앞에 not을 둔다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
문항.explanation: 창문은 닦이는 쪽이므로 to be + 과거분사로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
문항.explanation: expect는 목적격보어로 to부정사를 쓴다.

문항.포인트: To be frank with you = To tell the truth
문항.prompt: 밑줄 친 부분과 그 의미가 같은 것은?
body: <보기> [[To be frank with you]], the plan is not good.
문항.explanation: ‘솔직히 말하면’과 ‘사실대로 말하면’은 같은 뜻으로 쓰인다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈 칸에 가장 어울리는 것은?
문항.explanation: 뜻밖의 일을 말하고 있으므로 Strange to say가 알맞다.

문항.포인트: It is + 형용사 + for + 목적격 + to부정사
문항.prompt: 다음 <보기>의 문맥에 맞게 빈칸에 들어갈 단어로 알맞은 것은?
body: Emma loves to paint landscapes. It is
__________ for her to meet a famous painter
today, the artist she has admired for years. She
asked for advice and got it.
문항.explanation: 오래 존경한 화가를 만난 일이므로 ‘운이 좋다’는 fortunate가 알맞다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 [[어색한]]곳은?
choices: [[show]] that your activities are better than those
문항.explanation: persuade는 목적격보어로 to부정사를 쓰므로 to join으로 고쳐야 한다.
